import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    K = int(input[1])
    L = int(input[2])
    mod = 998244353

    fif = enumFIF(10000, mod)
    f, invf = fif

    muls = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        m = C(n, i, mod, fif)
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            sign = 1 if (j - i) % 2 == 0 else -1
            muls[j] += m * C(n - i, n - j, mod, fif) * sign
            muls[j] %= mod

    ans = 0
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        term = pow(2, i, mod) * f[0][i] % mod * f[0][i] % mod
        term = term * f[1][2 * i + 1] % mod * muls[i]
        ans += term
        ans %= mod

    ans = (ans + mod) % mod
    print((ans * L) % mod)

def C(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    f, invf = fif
    return f[n] * invf[r] % mod * invf[n - r] % mod

def pow(a, n, mod):
    result = 1
    base = a % mod
    for _ in range(n):
        result = result * base % mod
    return result

def enumFIF(n, mod):
    f = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod

    a = f[n]
    b = mod
    p, q = 1, 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        d = p
        p = q
        q = d - c * q
    invf_n = p % mod

    invf = [0] * (n + 1)
    invf[n] = invf_n
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod

    return [f, invf]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
